name: RHB Bank Berhad
overview: 今年 RHB Bank 的业务变化主要来自子公司精简：Utama Assets Sdn Bhd 于 9 月 10 日解散，Ke-Zan Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd 于 1 月 2 日解散，两者均不再为 RHB Bank 的子公司。此外，公司宣派了 2026 财政年的中期股息。
overview_en: RHB Bank's business changes this year mainly came from subsidiary streamlining: Utama Assets Sdn Bhd was dissolved on 10 September and Ke-Zan Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd was dissolved on 2 January, both ceasing to be subsidiaries of RHB Bank. In addition, the company declared interim dividends for the 2026 financial year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面主要涉及两家子公司的解散，以及中期股息的宣派。
segments.note_en: At the group level this year, the main events were the dissolution of two subsidiaries and the declaration of interim dividends.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 Utama Assets Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日根据《2016 年公司法》第 459(5) 条解散，不再为 RHB Bank 子公司。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Utama Assets Sdn Bhd was dissolved on 10 September 2026 pursuant to Section 459(5) of the Companies Act 2016 and ceased to be a subsidiary of RHB Bank.

actions.title: RHBBANK - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派单层中期股息每股 15.0 sen，除权日为 2026 年 9 月 14 日，支付日为 2026 年 9 月 29 日。
actions.text_en: Declared a single-tier interim dividend of 15.0 sen per share, with ex-date on 14 September 2026 and payment date on 29 September 2026.

actions.title: RHBBANK - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派单层中期股息每股 35.0 sen，除权日为 2026 年 3 月 13 日，支付日为 2026 年 3 月 30 日。
actions.text_en: Declared a single-tier interim dividend of 35.0 sen per share, with ex-date on 13 March 2026 and payment date on 30 March 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Ke-Zan Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 1 月 2 日根据《2016 年公司法》第 459(5) 条解散，不再为 RHB Bank 间接全资子公司。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Ke-Zan Nominees (Tempatan) Sdn Bhd was dissolved on 2 January 2026 pursuant to Section 459(5) of the Companies Act 2016 and ceased to be an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of RHB Bank.
